title: Separator (Textable)
description: String inserted between adjacent items when concatenating a sequence
documentation:
## Purpose
The infix string a concatenation cap places between adjacent items. Used by [Concat Text](https://capdag.com/browse/cap:concat;in=media:textable;out=media:textable) to glue a sequence of textable items into a single textable.

## When to use
Pass any UTF-8 string. The cap inserts the value between adjacent items only — never as a leading or trailing prefix on the merged output. Omit the argument for the cap's default separator (newline).

## Notes
Multi-byte UTF-8 separators are supported verbatim; the cap does not split or normalise them. An empty separator butts items directly together without any infix.

## Textable
Coercion marker indicating the value is faithfully representable as UTF-8 text.
Strings are textable trivially; integers and booleans are textable via their
string form; structured values are textable when JSON-serialised. Binary blobs
(images, audio, raw bytes) are NOT textable — converting them to text requires
explicit transformation that may be lossy.

The value is faithfully representable as UTF-8 text without loss.
